name: 003_preference_update
description: User updates a preference — new value should win, old value should be superseded.

episodes.text:
User: I eat meat regularly and love barbecue.
Assistant: Got it, I'll keep that in mind.

User: I've switched to a fully vegan diet now — no meat, dairy, or eggs. I don't eat meat anymore.
Assistant: Noted, updated your dietary preference to vegan.

User: Also I try to avoid processed foods.
Assistant: Good to know.

provenance_checks.episode_hint: switched to a fully vegan diet
